viewMode.label: Reading mode
viewMode.help: Show one page or scroll continuously through the document.

fitWindow.label: Fill window by default
fitWindow.help: On: fill the window. Off: show the entire page. Changes apply immediately.

showThumbnails.label: Show thumbnails by default
showThumbnails.help: Show the page thumbnail sidebar when opening a document. Changes apply immediately.

settings.label: 阅读模式
settings.help: 单页显示，或纵向连续滚动浏览文档。

settings.label: 默认适配窗口
settings.help: 开启时铺满窗口，关闭时完整显示整页；修改立即生效。

settings.label: 默认显示缩略图
settings.help: 打开文档时显示页面缩略图侧栏；修改立即生效。
